pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Desktop is Anthropic's Electron-based desktop app for Claude, with Chat, Cowork and Claude Code sessions. This package installs the official Debian build from Anthropic's APT repository.

use.flag: Pull in app-emulation/qemu, app-emulation/virtiofsd and OVMF firmware for the Cowork virtual machine, and link the firmware into /usr/share/OVMF
